Static fixture decoding confirms the new attachment byte counts; no converter or test run establishes runtime coverage."

      "status": "examined-with-complete-retained-context",
      "summary": [
        "The loopback OAuth listener now tracks separate streams and buffers for each accepted connection. A stream-availability failure closes only that connection, while a completed or rejected request can claim the listener and close the others. The new test keeps an idle connection open before submitting the mock callback; it does not directly exercise a closed idle connection. Oversized partial input can reject before CRLF, and no native network or test execution ran."
      ],
